gen-gf-prosto-one-fs-ranade: Distinctive and tall, Prosto One strides wide across the line. Ranade follows with slight, rubbery weight shifts and far-apart stroke ends, so the display lettering gets a loose, organic partner underneath.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-: The lowercase g in Revalia leaves its lower curve open. Revalia brings bold, widely spaced display swagger; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next handles the reading, with big-eyed lowercase and rounds that stay unlatched.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-open-sans: Loud, loose and tall: Revalia strides wide with a g left open below. Open Sans sits beneath with smooth, bulky lowercase shapes and no clogged curves, so the heading's swagger has a sturdy partner.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-strait: Revalia leaves the lower curve of its g open, giving bold lines a relaxed, wide stride. Strait follows with big round lowercase bowls, so text moves along in an approachable, contemporary way.
gen-gf-revalia-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans glows like neon tubing, its strokes never varying in weight, while Revalia brings bold, wide-striding headings. Bold expression up top, clean restraint below; that split is the draw.
gen-gf-risque-fs-rowan: Expressive and distinctive, Risque takes the heading. Rowan, literary and friendly with generous curve openings, is made for brief reading, and that warmth against the showy heading is the real draw.
gen-gf-roboto-mono-fs-ranade: Roboto Mono lays down fixed-width, code-style letters with wide-mouthed rounds. Ranade loosens things up, its gently shifting weight and spread-out spacing making longer text feel organic and unhurried.
gen-gf-saira-extra-condensed-fs-karma: Tight, tall and uniform: Saira Extra Condensed stands in narrow ranks. Karma brings a mild shift from heavy stems to lighter curves, lending a trustworthy, classic feel to the heading's unvarying strokes.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-roundo: Shantell Sans has wide mouths and one fixed nib width. It carries the personality, while Roundo, geometric and quiet, keeps small counters unclogged and the n's arch matched to its stem.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-special-gothic: Shantell Sans keeps every joint smooth, with no thinning or bulging where strokes meet. Special Gothic follows with rounded, open letters, so text moves along in an approachable, modern way.
